GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (18 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN-617)
18 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Nationals in Sweden.
1. Reference is made to letter, C.L.O. No. 93 (5.1), dated 8 January 1946, subject: "Transfer of Custody of Japanese Diplomatic Proparty and Archives in Sweden."
2. So much of paragraph 4 above reference as pertains to diplomatic and consular members in Sweden desiring repatriation was brought to the attention of the United States Government on a previous occasion. Refer to memorandum this headquarters, file AG 370.05 (24 Dec 45)GC, dated 24 December 1945, subject: "Repatriation of Japanese Diplomatic and Consular Members and Others."
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will furnish this headquarters a list of Japanese nationals in Sweden for whom repatriation is desired. This list of persons will not include any names already reported in C.L.O. No. 990 (5.2), dated 10 December 1945, subject: "Repatriation of Japanese Diplomatic, Consular and Certain Non-Official Personnel."
4. This confirms verbal information given the Central liaison Office (Mr Ushiba) 16 January 1946.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel,AGD
Asst Adjutant General.
